title: Yours Truly on Full Stack Creator, Talking About the New MacBook Pros With PROLED XDR Displays
content:
Tyler Stalman and David Altizer were kind enough to have me on their show this week. These new MacBook Pros are very fun computers that are very fun to talk about.

(We even sneak in some love for Ricoh’s legendary GR line of compact cameras. I used my original GR-D from 20 years ago to shoot this 2010 photo of Steve Jobs and Walt Mossberg that I linked to in my feature-length “Touch and Glow” piece yesterday.)

 ★
author: John Gruber
